name: Fairfield by Marriott Cebu Mandaue City
short_description: Select-service Fairfield by Marriott hotel in Mandaue City on Cebu's main island, with a Japanese-influenced design, rooftop deck and outdoor pool, roughly 15 minutes from Mactan-Cebu airport.
ai_summary: Opened in December 2023 as the first Fairfield by Marriott in the Philippines, this nine-story, 142-room hotel sits in Mandaue City's Ibabao-Estancia district on Cebu's main island, close to the bridges linking to Mactan and about 15 minutes from the airport. It is an uncomplicated select-service property aimed at business and value travelers, with a Japanese-influenced, pared-back design. Reviewers consistently praise the attentive, friendly staff, spotless and bright rooms with comfortable beds, and strong value for a Marriott-branded stay. Facilities include a rooftop deck with city views, an outdoor pool, a 24-hour fitness center, an all-day restaurant serving Filipino and international dishes, and three barangay-named meeting rooms. Watch-outs are mostly about location and format: the hotel sits in a business/industrial pocket with little walkable dining or shopping, so guests rely on taxis or Grab. Some reviewers dislike the open-concept bathroom separated only by a sliding door, describe the buffet breakfast spread as modest, and note breakfast is not always bundled into the rate. As a Fairfield, it offers no executive lounge, and elite recognition is limited compared with full-service Marriott brands. Overall it reads as a clean, reliable, well-priced airport-area base rather than a resort or destination stay.

faqs.question: How far is the hotel from Mactan-Cebu International Airport?
faqs.answer: The hotel sits in Mandaue City on Cebu's main island, roughly 9 km and about 15 minutes by car from Mactan-Cebu International Airport, though it can be as quick as 10 minutes by taxi when traffic across the Mactan bridges is light.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included at Fairfield by Marriott Cebu Mandaue City?
faqs.answer: Breakfast is served daily at the all-day restaurant, but it is not always bundled into the room rate, so guests should confirm at booking. Reviewers describe the buffet as decent and satisfactory though somewhat limited in spread compared with larger hotels.

faqs.question: What facilities does the hotel offer?
faqs.answer: Facilities include an outdoor swimming pool, a rooftop deck with city views, a 24-hour fitness center, an all-day restaurant serving Filipino and international dishes, a grab-and-go market, and three meeting rooms named after local barangays for events and business functions.
